title: mediawiki/page/change
description: Represents a MediaWiki page state change in a changelog. This event models all state changes to MediaWiki pages. It supersedes the other page and revision based event models. See: https://phabricator.wikimedia.org/T308017

$schema.description: A URI identifying the JSONSchema for this event. This should match an schema's $id in a schema repository. E.g. /schema/title/1.0.0

changelog_kind.description: The kind of this event in a changelog. This is used to map the event to an action in a data store.

comment.description: The comment left by the user that performed this change. Same as revision.comment on edits.

created_redirect_page.title: fragment/mediawiki/state/entity/page
created_redirect_page.description: Page entity that was created at the old title during a page move. This is only set for page move events. Note that the created_redirect_page will also have its own associated page create event.

is_redirect.description: True if the page is a redirect page at the time of this event.

namespace_id.description: The id of the namespace this page belongs to. This value can be negative.

namespace_is_content.description: True if the namespace of the page is a content namespace (via $wgContentNamespaces) at the time of this event.

page_id.description: The (database) page ID of the page.

page_title.description: The normalized title of the page.

revision_count.description: NOTE: revision_count is never set for created_redirect_page. It is present here for backwards compatibility only.

dt.description: ISO-8601 formatted timestamp of when the event occurred/was generated in UTC), AKA 'event time'. This is different than meta.dt, which is used as the time the system received this event.

domain.description: Domain the event or entity pertains to

dt.description: Time the event was received by the system, in UTC ISO-8601 format

request_id.description: Unique ID of the request that caused the event

stream.description: Name of the stream (dataset) that this event belongs in

uri.description: Unique URI identifying the event or entity

is_redirect.description: True if the page is a redirect page at the time of this event.

namespace_id.description: The id of the namespace this page belongs to. This value can be negative.

namespace_is_content.description: True if the namespace of the page is a content namespace (via $wgContentNamespaces) at the time of this event.

page_id.description: The (database) page ID of the page.

page_title.description: The normalized title of the page.

redirect_page_link.title: fragment/mediawiki/state/entity/page_link
redirect_page_link.description: If this page is currently a redirect, then this field contains information about the target page the redirect links to.

interwiki_prefix.description: The interwiki prefix (iw_prefix) of this link. The presence of this prefix implies a target outside the local wiki. See https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Help:Interwiki_linking

is_redirect.description: True if the page is a redirect page at the time of this event.

namespace_id.description: The id of the namespace this page belongs to. This value can be negative.

namespace_is_content.description: True if the namespace of the page is a content namespace (via $wgContentNamespaces) at the time of this event.

page_id.description: The (database) page ID of the page.

page_title.description: The normalized title of the page.

wikibase_concept_uri.description: The concept URI of the wikibase_item_id of the page that this link targets.

wikibase_item_id.description: Wikibase entity id (a.k.a. item id) associated with the page that this link targets.

wikibase_wiki_id.description: The wiki ID of the Wikibase repository that hosts the wikibase_item_id of the page that this link targets.

revision_count.description: The number of revisions of this page at the time of this event. During a delete, this number of revisions will be archived. This field is likely only set for page delete events, as getting this information on all events is expensive.

wikibase_concept_uri.description:
The concept URI of wikibase_item_id, e.g. "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/Q42".
This is the identifier of the item as an RDF resource, built from the concept base URI of the Wikibase that hosts it. It identifies the item and is not guaranteed to be a resolvable URL.
Absent whenever wikibase_item_id is absent.

wikibase_item_id.description:
Wikibase entity id (a.k.a. item id) associated with this page. On Wikimedia production wikis this is likely a Wikidata Q-id, e.g. "Q937".
Absent when the producing wiki does not have Wikibase Client enabled, or when no Wikibase item is associated with this page. Only items are set here; other kinds of Wikibase entity associated with a page are not, e.g. the MediaInfo entity of a Commons file page.
The value likely comes from the `page_props` MediaWiki table. As such, it is technically the value of the `wikibase_item` page property at the time of this event, which may change asynchronously for this page at a later time. In practice, wikibase_item_ids rarely change for a page once they are set, so this field is useful in most cases, even if it may sometimes be inaccurate.

wikibase_wiki_id.description: The wiki ID of the Wikibase that hosts wikibase_item_id e.g. "wikidatawiki". Absent whenever wikibase_item_id is absent.

page_change_kind.description: The origin kind of the change to this page as viewed by MediaWiki.

performer.title: fragment/mediawiki/state/entity/user
performer.description: Represents the MediaWiki actor that made this change. If this change is an edit, this will be the same as revision.editor.

edit_count.description: The number of edits this user has made at the time of this event. Not present for non permanent users.

edit_global_count.description: The user's global (cross-wiki) edit count at the time of this event, as tracked by CentralAuth. Only present for users with an initialized CentralAuth global account; not present for users without a global account or when the global edit count has not yet been initialized.

first_edit_dt.description: The datetime of the user account's first edit. Not present for non-existent/anonymous users.

groups.description: A list of the groups this user belongs to.  E.g. bot, sysop etc. Not present for non permanent users.

is_bot.description: True if this user is considered to be a bot at the time of this event. This is checked via the $user->isBot() method, which considers both user_groups and user permissions.

is_system.description: True if the user is a MediaWiki 'system' user. These are users that cannot 'authenticate'.  These are usually listed in ReservedUsernames.

is_temp.description: True if the user is an autocreated temporary MediaWiki user. This is used for IP masking.

registration_dt.description: The datetime of the user account registration. Not present for non permanent users or if missing in the MW database.

user_id.description: MediaWiki User ID. This is optional, and will not be present for non permanent users.

user_text.description: The user name or text representation of the user that performed this change.

wiki_id.description: The wiki ID of the wiki the user belongs to.

prior_state.description: Prior state of this page before this event. Fields are only present if their values have changed.

is_redirect.description: True if the page is a redirect page at the time of this event.

namespace_id.description: The id of the namespace this page belongs to. This value can be negative.

namespace_is_content.description: True if the namespace of the page is a content namespace (via $wgContentNamespaces) at the time of this event.

page_id.description: The (database) page ID of the page.

page_title.description: The normalized title of the page.

revision_count.description: NOTE: prior_state.page.revision_count is unlikely to be set, as getting the # of revisions previous to this change is difficult. This field is present here for backwards compatibiliy.

comment.description: The comment left by the editor when this revision was made.

content_slots.title: fragment/mediawiki/state/entity/revision_slots
content_slots.description: Map type representing MediaWiki's revision content slots. This map is keyed by the slot role name, e.g. 'main'.

content_body.description: Content body. NOTE: This field is not required, and is often not set in streams as it can make events very large. It is included here for events that do include the content body.

content_format.description: The 'content type' of the content.  E.g. wikitext/html. This is similiar to a MIME type.

content_model.description: MediaWiki's content model of this content. E.g. wikitext, json, etc.

content_sha1.description: sha1 sum of the content body.

content_size.description: Byte size of the content body.

origin_rev_id.description: Revision in which this slot was originally created

slot_role.description: Slot role name. Should be the same as the map key.

editor.description: Represents the MediaWiki user that made this edit.

edit_count.description: The number of edits this user has made at the time of this event. Not present for non permanent users.

edit_global_count.description: The user's global (cross-wiki) edit count at the time of this event, as tracked by CentralAuth. Only present for users with an initialized CentralAuth global account; not present for users without a global account or when the global edit count has not yet been initialized.

first_edit_dt.description: The datetime of the user account's first edit. Not present for non-existent/anonymous users.

groups.description: A list of the groups this user belongs to.  E.g. bot, sysop etc. Not present for non permanent users.

is_bot.description: True if this user is considered to be a bot at the time of this event. This is checked via the $user->isBot() method, which considers both user_groups and user permissions.

is_system.description: True if the user is a MediaWiki 'system' user. These are users that cannot 'authenticate'.  These are usually listed in ReservedUsernames.

is_temp.description: True if the user is an autocreated temporary MediaWiki user. This is used for IP masking.

registration_dt.description: The datetime of the user account registration. Not present for non permanent users or if missing in the MW database.

user_id.description: MediaWiki User ID. This is optional, and will not be present for non permanent users.

user_text.description: The user name or text representation of the user that performed this change.

wiki_id.description: The wiki ID of the wiki the user belongs to.

is_comment_visible.description: Whether the comment of the revision is visible. See RevisionRecord->DELETED_COMMENT.

is_content_visible.description: Whether the revision's content body is visible. If this is false, then content should be redacted. See RevisionRecord->DELETED_TEXT

is_editor_visible.description: Whether the revision's editor information is visible. Affects editor field. See RevisionRecord->DELETED_USER

is_minor_edit.description: True if the editor marked this revision as a minor edit.

rev_dt.description: Time this revision was created. This is rev_timestamp in the MediaWiki database.

rev_sha1.description: sha1 sum considering all the content slots for this revision.

rev_size.description: Byte size 'sum' of all the content slots for this revision. This 'size' is approximate, but may not be exact, depending on the kind of data that is stored in the content slots.

comment.description: The comment left by the editor when this revision was made.
